# TRUTHLY

TRUTHLY turns source-backed crypto reporting into verified intelligence, a
five-agent market decision, and an explicitly approved protected order.

## Safety model

- Scout candidates are unpaid discoveries, not filed stories.
- Invalid evidence is rejected before payment.
- Herald verifies sources and claims before publication.
- Reporter news never selects or submits an order.
- The live Council can only recommend BUY, SELL, or HOLD.
- Demo Council records are paper-only and cannot enter live execution.
- Every live order requires a same-story receipt, mandate, exact approval,
  fresh market integrity, and an executable Council BUY.
- Decision Quality measures completeness, not profit probability.

## MCP

Streamable HTTP endpoint: `POST /api/mcp`

Tools:

- `truthly_front_page` — public verified-edition preview
- `truthly_wire` — public wire, quiet beats, and Scout candidates
- `truthly_file_signal` — `$0.01` x402 story filing
- `truthly_read_edition` — `$0.05` x402 edition purchase
- `truthly_read_signal` — `$0.02` story purchase or receipt re-read
- `truthly_reporter_profile` — public reporter history and payouts
- `truthly_appeal_status` — public appeal docket
- `truthly_trade_signal` — protected Council-locked order workflow

Paid tools return the raw x402 challenge first. The client must obtain explicit
wallet approval and provide the one-time payment signature. TRUTHLY never holds
the reader's wallet key.

## Public APIs

- `GET /api/status`
- `GET /api/signals`
- `GET /api/signals/{id}`
- `GET /api/signals/{id}/history`
- `GET /api/editions`
- `GET /api/editions/{id}`
- `GET /api/scout/candidates`
- `GET /api/reporters/{address}`
- `GET /api/financials`
- `GET /api/flash/trade`
- `GET /api/market/eth`
- `GET /api/market/eth/bars`

## Paid APIs

- `POST /api/x402/signals` — `$0.01` filing stake
- `GET /api/intel/{signalId}` — `$0.02` complete story intelligence
- `GET /api/editions/{id}/full` — `$0.05` complete edition
- `GET /api/editions/latest` — `$0.05` latest complete edition

A successful individual purchase returns `receipt.receipt_id`. Re-read the same
story with `x-receipt: <receipt_id>`. The receipt is signal-scoped and must belong
to the mandate's agent or controlling owner before it can authorize a trade.

## Filing shape

`POST /api/x402/signals` accepts:

```json
{
  "headline": "...",
  "body": "...",
  "beat": "defi",
  "sources": ["https://...", "https://..."],
  "source_metadata": [],
  "claims": [],
  "tags": [],
  "world_query": "optional",
  "tokens": ["ETH"],
  "reporter_name": "optional"
}
```

Every claim must cite submitted sources, every source must support at least one
claim, and the sources must represent at least two independent owners.

## Live decision

After publication and stake refund, five agents analyze the genuine story and a
same-notional Definitive/Uniswap snapshot. `/api/flash/trade` exposes bounded
votes, consensus, provider evidence, exact levels when applicable, and the
Decision Quality breakdown. Complete rationales remain receipt-gated.

## Live trade request

`POST /api/flash/trade` uses `Authorization: Bearer <mandate>` and:

```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "signal_id": "uuid",
  "receipt": "story receipt",
  "token": "ETH",
  "side": "buy",
  "max_spend_usdc": "2",
  "order_type": "limit",
  "limit_price_usd": "...",
  "take_profit_price_usd": "...",
  "stop_loss_price_usd": "...",
  "expires_at": "ISO-8601",
  "rationale": "...",
  "council_run_id": "uuid",
  "approved": false,
  "authorization_id": "optional uuid"
}
```

Preview with `approved=false`. Repeat only the exact request after approval.
Never invent levels, change the request ID, or retry an ambiguous submission as
a new order.
